editor.yaml_disclaimer: Please use yaml mode for the other options

fields.title: Title
fields.energy_date_selection: Sync with the energy date picker
fields.name: Name
fields.carbon_split: Split the grid by carbon intensity

editor.preview_hint: Edit the chart in the preview: click a node to edit it, drag a node to another section to move it, or drag its handle onto another node to link them.

helpers.autoconfig: Builds the chart from your energy dashboard settings.
helpers.energy_date_selection: Shows the period picked in the energy date picker of this dashboard.
helpers.energy_collection_key: Only needed when the dashboard has more than one energy date picker.
helpers.time_period_from: For example now-1d or now/d. Turns off the energy date picker.
helpers.min_state: Hides nodes with a smaller value. Nodes with a value of 0 are always hidden.
helpers.static_scale: The value that fills the whole card.
helpers.ignore_missing_entities: Treats missing entities as 0 instead of showing an error.
helpers.net_flows: Turn off to show grid export and battery charging next to imports.
helpers.carbon_split: Needs a CO2 signal entity in the energy dashboard.
helpers.print_yaml: Shows the generated config under the card.
helpers.entity_id: Use it when the ID is not the entity to read, for example to show one entity twice.
helpers.add_entities: Their values are added to this node.
helpers.subtract_entities: Their values are subtracted from this node.
helpers.children_sum: What to do when this node and the sum of its children differ.
helpers.parents_sum: What to do when this node and the sum of its parents differ.
helpers.filters: Changes the value before it is shown, for example multiply: -1.
helpers.double_tap_action: When not set, a double tap does the tap action.

autoconfig.customize_help: Turns the generated chart into nodes and links you can edit, and turns off autoconfig.
autoconfig.waiting: Available once the preview has built the chart.

node.name_yaml: This name can only be changed in YAML.
node.color_yaml: This node uses color ranges, which can only be changed in YAML.
node.duplicate_id: Another node already uses the ID {id}.

incomplete.passthrough: Needs an incoming and an outgoing link
incomplete.alert: Until then, the card shows an error on the dashboard.

links.none_later: There are no nodes in later sections to link to.
links.none_earlier: There are no nodes in earlier sections to link from.
links.all_linked_later: This node already links to every node in later sections.
links.all_linked_earlier: Every node in earlier sections already links to this node.
links.connection_for: Connection entity for the link to {name}

link.title: Link
link.connection_helper: Optional. An entity that sets how much flows over this link.

toast.links_dropped_one: Removed 1 link, because links can only point to later sections.
toast.links_dropped_other: Removed {count} links, because links can only point to later sections.
toast.manual_cleared: Removed the manual nodes and links.
toast.autoconfig_off: Turned off autoconfig. The chart is empty until you add nodes.

preview.link_handle: Drag onto another node to link them
preview.hidden_node: Hidden in the card: its value is 0 or below the minimum state
